name: Fresh Meat
description: Newly recruited. The paperwork is still damp.

name: Monster Botherer
description: Defeated something that probably wanted to be left alone.

name: Certified Floor Inspector
description: Extensive professional experience with the ground.

name: Needle Dodger
description: Mostly successful at not becoming a pincushion.

name: Grudge Survivor
description: A Tonberry remembers. Unfortunately, so do you.

name: Bomb Disposal Officer
description: The Guild's definition of disposal is surprisingly violent.

name: Tidebreaker
description: Sahagin royalty has filed a formal complaint.

name: Needle Threader
description: Caught the fast green bastard.

name: Cat Problem Solver
description: Solved a very large, electrified cat problem.

name: Blade Witness
description: Saw the Riven Ronin draw. Somehow still here.

name: Fresh Air Advocate
description: Has opinions about Malboro breath.

name: Giant Feller
description: Turns out they do fall down.

name: Moonbreaker
description: Three heads. Still not enough.

name: Still Not Stabbed
description: The lantern got close. Too close.

name: Warranty Voider
description: Magitek maintenance declined to comment.

name: Behemoth Botherer
description: A lifestyle choice with poor actuarial outcomes.

name: Geological Incident
description: Defeated something that was basically terrain.

name: Riftwalker
description: Went beyond the veil and came back with loot.

name: Oathkeeper
description: Completed the Oath of Light.

name: Abyss Walker
description: Stared into the abyss. It asked you to stop staring.

name: Skybound
description: Gravity is now more of a suggestion.

name: Shadowstep
description: Definitely standing behind you right now.

name: Aethercaller
description: Has extremely powerful imaginary friends.

name: Aetheric Field Researcher
description: Monster science, with considerably more hitting.

name: Wandering Minstrel
description: Has enough road stories to make the rest of the tavern nervous.

name: Licensed Tinkerer
description: The license is mostly decorative.

name: Crystal Scholar
description: Knows enough magic to become everyone else's problem.

name: Master of One
description: Mastered a Job to level 50.

name: Mark Hunter
description: Cleared ten Hunts.

name: S-Rank Problem
description: Defeated an S-Rank mark. Concerningly enthusiastic about doing it again.

name: Guild Artisan
description: Craft 25 items.

name: Hammer Time
description: Complete 10 forge upgrades.

name: Relic Bearer
description: Complete your first Zenith Relic.

name: Rift Delver
description: Reach the Interdimensional Rift.

name: Certified Tent Inspector
description: Has spent enough time at camp to have opinions about tent stakes.

name: Strength in Numbers
description: Answers enough encounter rallies that solo adventuring now feels suspicious.

name: Phoenix Wrangler
description: Has revived enough raid members to qualify as emergency services.

name: Limit Break Enthusiast
description: Believes every problem can be solved by waiting for the gauge to glow.

name: Seasoned Wayfarer
description: Has been outside so long the Guild stopped expecting a timely return.

name: World-Worn
description: Every road has a story. Most of them involve monsters and questionable snacks.

name: Crystal Veteran
description: Has survived enough adventures to become part of the scenery.

name: Legend in Residence
description: Reached the level cap. The Guild has run out of sensible advice.

name: Monster Menace
description: Local wildlife has begun filing incident reports.

name: Ecological Incident
description: A statistically concerning number of monsters are no longer with us.

name: Damage Dealer
description: Numbers go up. Monsters go down. Accounting remains nervous.

name: Walking Calculation Error
description: Damage totals have become a threat to spreadsheet stability.

name: Big Number Enjoyer
description: Believes punctuation in damage numbers is a moral victory.

name: Guild Paramedic
description: Has restored enough HP to qualify for extremely unofficial medical credentials.

name: Floor Tank
description: Aggressively controls the horizontal plane.

name: Professional Floor Tank
description: The floor knows you by name.

name: Monster Librarian
description: Catalogues wildlife by repeatedly hitting it.

name: Walking Bestiary
description: Knows every monster in the catalog and several of their legal representatives.

name: Everyone’s Grudge
description: Has made the Tonberry community collectively aware of their existence.

name: Breath Taker
description: Has spent far too much time near Malboros and somehow still has opinions.

name: Hunt Board Terror
description: The Hunt Board updates itself when you walk into the room.

name: Mark of Marks
description: The marks are beginning to post bounties on you.

name: S-Rank Repeat Offender
description: One S-Rank was apparently not enough evidence.

name: Polymath
description: Mastered enough Jobs to make specialization look optional.

name: Every Job Is My Main Job
description: Mastered the entire Job roster. Please choose a personality.

name: Career Adventurer
description: Has put in enough combat hours to request benefits. Request denied.

name: Gil Hoarder
description: Can hear a dropped coin from three regions away.

name: Gil Tycoon
description: Has enough gil to begin making deeply irresponsible purchasing decisions.

name: Economic Stimulus
description: Personally responsible for keeping several Moogles employed.

name: Master Artisan
description: Crafted enough equipment to start criticizing other people’s hammer technique.

name: Anvil Abuser
description: The blacksmith has asked you to stop making eye contact with the forge.

name: Relic Collector
description: One legendary weapon was not sufficiently dramatic.

name: Arsenal of Legend
description: Completed every Relic line. Storage space has become theoretical.

name: Raid Regular
description: Shows up when the boss music starts instead of leaving like a sensible person.

name: World Saver, Part-Time
description: Has saved the world often enough that it should really be salaried.

name: Eikon on Speed Dial
description: Summons ancient powers with the casual confidence of ordering takeout.

name: Gauge Watcher
description: Has stared at the Limit bar long enough to see through time.

name: Phoenix Dispatcher
description: Runs an unofficial resurrection logistics department.

name: Boss Botherer
description: Has defeated enough bosses that dramatic entrances are losing their effect.

name: Professional Problem
description: Supernatural threats have begun recognizing the username.

name: Judged and Found Annoying
description: Penance rendered judgment. You objected successfully.

name: Contract Violator
description: Yiazmat had a health bar. You treated it as a suggestion.

name: Absolutely Unreasonable
description: Defeated Absolute Virtue. The name of this title is also the diagnosis.

name: Grudge Magnet
description: Tonberries keep finding you. At this point, consider changing your number.

name: Breath Test Failure
description: Has been KO’d by Malboro enough times to identify Bad Breath by vintage.

name: Tent Landlord
description: Has spent enough nights camping to demand zoning rights.

name: Party Animal
description: Has joined enough rallies to make solo play feel suspicious.

name: Goblin Negotiator
description: Negotiations were brief, loud, and conducted with weapons.

name: Packbreaker
description: The Alpha howled. You answered with paperwork and violence.

name: Royal Pest Control
description: Handled a queen-sized stinging problem without a very large rolled newspaper.

name: Bone to Pick
description: You had one. The skeleton had considerably more.

name: Emerald Pathfinder
description: Mapped every road, ruin, and suspiciously aggressive shrub in the Emerald Wilds.

name: Highland Surveyor
description: Charted the Ashen Highlands without becoming part of the geology.

name: Mistfen Delver
description: Returned from every drowned road the Mistfen tried to keep.

name: Frostveil Warden
description: Mastered the Reach and developed strong opinions about adequate socks.

name: Scarwalker
description: Mapped the Astral Scar despite reality repeatedly objecting.

name: Master Cartographer
description: Mapped every Expedition region. The Guild has reluctantly stopped asking if you are lost.

name: Saucer Regular
description: Knows exactly which counter has the shortest line.

name: Cactpot Connoisseur
description: Can turn nine little numbers into a very serious discussion.

name: Jackpot Chaser
description: The reels have definitely noticed you by now.

name: Toss Tactician
description: Knows exactly when the sensible target is a trap.

name: Pot Shot Pro
description: Five throws, several broken pots, absolutely no apologies.

name: Feathered Finisher
description: Always finds one more straightaway in the tank.

name: Circuit Champion
description: The checkered flag has started recognizing you on sight.

name: Triad Tactician
description: Can see a capture from four sides away.

name: Card Hall Master
description: The card hall has stopped pretending this is a casual visit.
